svg.title: One causal self-attention head
svg.desc: The input X has T rows and d_model columns. Multiplication by W_Q, W_K and W_V produces Q, K and V with T rows and d_head columns. Transposing K allows QK transpose to form the square score matrix S. Divide by the square root of d_head, mask only future positions j greater than i, then apply row-wise softmax to obtain A. A times V gives the head output. All three grids show six by six examples of T by T matrices, including the unmasked diagonal.
svg.text: Attention(Q, K, V) = softmax(QKᵀ / √dhead + mask) V
Square grids show T = 6. Rows are queries; columns are keys.
